provenance: github.com/stan-dev/posteriordb, reference posteriors (10 chains x 1000 thinned draws of long Stan runs). Summaries computed with tools/stan_analyze_reference.py.
acceptance_rule: for each parameter: |mean_scala - mean_ref| <= 4 * sqrt(mcse_scala^2 + mcse_ref^2), and the same for sd with mcse_sd

posteriors.why: autoregression, like the AR(1) latent rate
bounded and positive parameters, recursive likelihood
Poisson likelihood with a latent vector
